pictures.name: MKB1-Mango-Tree
pictures.prompt: A vast, ancient mango tree heavy with golden fruit leaning over a wide moonlit river in ancient India. On a high branch sits the monkey king (a large, noble golden-furred monkey with wise amber eyes and a silver-tipped crown of fur), watching over a large troop of smaller monkeys among the leaves. Gold lamplight-like moon glow on the fruit, deep blue river and sky. Contemplative sacred oil painting, one tall 9:16 picture, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow quiet mood, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
